bottleneck: On partial-observation runs with no visible task objects, the agent emits consecutive waits and scores 0 (both frontier and mirror cases) because nothing drives discovery of new tiles.
rationale: In 'partial-observation-frontier' and 'partial-observation-frontier-mirror', observation shows only the agent's own tile, zero parcels/keys/doors/batteries, and the baseline waited twice ('No visible parcel can be selected'). The fix activates only when no task object is visible, then picks the first unvisited in-bounds neighbor computed from optional width/height bounds plus positions recorded in context.memory (array of {x,y,action,module}), so the direction is derived per-instance rather than constant and mirrors safely. It returns undefined whenever a parcel, key, door, or battery is visible (protecting key-door-delivery, battery-return, simple-delivery, two-parcels, detour-delivery) and waits only when the local frontier is exhausted or energy is exactly 0.
expectedMetric: partial-observation-frontier and partial-observation-frontier-mirror: waits drop from 2 to at most 1, first action becomes a valid in-bounds move, score goes from 0 to > 0; all five achieved benchmarks remain achieved.
source: (context) => { const o = context && context.observation; if (!o || !o.me) return undefined; const me = o.me; if ((o.parcels && o.parcels.length) || (o.keys && o.keys.length) || (o.doors && o.doors.length) || (o.batteries && o.batteries.length)) return undefined; const visited = new Set(); visited.add(me.x + ',' + me.y); const mem = context && Array.isArray(context.memory) ? context.memory : []; for (const m of mem) { if (m && m.x !== undefined && m.y !== undefined) visited.add(m.x + ',' + m.y); } const inB = (x, y) => (o.width === undefined || (x >= 0 && x < o.width)) && (o.height === undefined || (y >= 0 && y < o.height)); const dirs = [['down', 0, 1], ['left', -1, 0], ['right', 1, 0], ['up', 0, -1]]; const cand = dirs.filter((d) => inB(me.x + d[1], me.y + d[2]) && !visited.has((me.x + d[1]) + ',' + (me.y + d[2]))); if (!cand.length) return { action: { kind: 'wait', reason: 'frontier-exhausted' }, confidence: 0.5, rationale: 'All in-bounds neighbors are already visited; no unvisited frontier remains.' }; if (o.energy === 0) return { action: { kind: 'wait', reason: 'no-energy-for-move' }, confidence: 0.6, rationale: 'Energy is zero and every move costs energy, so defer the exploration move.' }; const c = cand[0]; return { action: { kind: 'move', direction: c[0] }, confidence: 0.7, rationale: 'No visible task; expanding the partial-observation frontier to the first unvisited in-bounds neighbor (' + c[0] + ') using width/height bounds and memory.' }; }
